name: Covenant from Above
description: (Tag:holy)(Tag:meta)"Devotion at a price." A gold scroll trimmed in silver granting equal-rank Summon Angel without using an ability slot when signed in blood after offering 3 equal-level sacrifices (Abilities, Items, etc.; Skills and Familiars excluded), e.g. an Elite Ability plus 2 Elite Items for Summon Angel (Elite). Single use upon signing; refundable for free to reclaim its ticket.
